_about: Card names (and where noted the Latin name) as BGA's own log calls them; the fan site's data has older or misspelt ones. Applied by scripts/import_data.py to src/ark_nova/data/*.json (so a re-import keeps them) and by scripts/cardgen/harness/entry.tsx to the card images. Found by comparing the card_name of every card in the sample logs with our data. The bga_id keeps BGA's own spelling (it is used to match, never shown).
